title: Network specialist
_note: Technical round built from the Network specialist tasks in content/reference/occupations.json, which the team wrote from the eMASCO title (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2523-01) and has not yet checked against the eMASCO task list. Behavioural round: behavioural.json. Rubric format: content/interview/sets.ts.

questions.text: How would you design the network for a small office of 30 staff with Wi-Fi, printers and a server?
questions.why: network specialists plan networks that work on day one and grow later.
questions.source: 2523-01 task 1 (content/reference/occupations.json): Design and set up computer networks for an organisation. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

questions.text: Users in one department say the network keeps dropping. How would you find and fix the fault?
questions.source: 2523-01 task 2 (content/reference/occupations.json): Monitor network performance and fix faults. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: find the scope of the problem
check the physical layer and devices

questions.text: How do you keep a network secure, and how would you plan for it to grow, including cloud services?
questions.why: networks must stay safe as the organisation grows.
questions.source: 2523-01 task 3 (content/reference/occupations.json): Keep networks secure and plan for growth, including cloud services. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: control access with a firewall and rules
separate networks and use strong Wi-Fi security
